display_long_description:
# You are made of what surrounds you.

**Kithin is a shared 3D space where the people, things and places around you become part of your experience.**

Grab something. Use it. Keep it. Give it to someone. Take it somewhere completely different.

**If it works here, it works everywhere.**

## Take anything with you

Objects aren't trapped inside the world where you found them. Keep something you like and bring it somewhere else — it will still work.

A paintbrush still paints. A gadget keeps its behavior. A game stays a game.

See something interesting? **Pick it up and find out what it does.**

## Yes, even worlds

Entire worlds can become objects you can hold, keep, share and activate.

Take a world into another world. Give it to a friend. Step inside.

## Better together

Invite others, interact with the same things and talk naturally with spatial voice. Found something cool? Hand it to someone.

## Make something

Create toys, tools, gadgets, games or entire places with **Kithin Studio**.

Build it once. Take it anywhere.

**Bring your friends. Bring your things. Make something new.**
